neighbours.label: an effort or commitment to keep, retain or preserve something as it is (been able to maintain, prides itself on retaining, tried to preserve), as against the same subjects replacing, losing or simply doing something
fire: Through all the changes, the village has managed to keep its old market square.
The school takes pride in retaining its most experienced teachers.
The owners worked hard to preserve the original stained glass windows.
Even after the merger, the brewery tried to maintain its traditional recipes.
The club has always made an effort to keep ticket prices low for families.
Volunteers fight to protect the last stretch of ancient woodland.
Despite the fame, she has worked to stay true to her roots.
The new owners promised to conserve the historic character of the hotel.
quiet: Through all the changes, the village has lost its old market square.
The school fired its most experienced teachers last year.
The owners smashed the original stained glass windows by accident.
After the merger, the brewery replaced its traditional recipes.
The club raised ticket prices for families this season.
Developers cut down the last stretch of ancient woodland.
After the fame, she moved away from her home town.
The new owners painted the hotel bright pink.
